verdict.rationale: Plaid handles sensitive user financial data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any AI-training data policy. Community privacy complaints concern data scraping and consent UI, not AI model training, so they neither support nor contradict this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
